tools.name: get_live_scores
tools.description: Return currently in-progress games across all sports (or one sport). Each row carries home/away teams and scores, league, a derived status, the live clock/period marker, and data_age_seconds (source freshness at serve time). Keyless, free.

tools.name: get_scores_by_date
tools.description: Return all events on a calendar date (UTC, "YYYY-MM-DD"), optionally filtered to one sport. Same unified schema and freshness field as get_live_scores. Use for finals, fixtures, and a full day board. Keyless, free.

tools.name: list_sports
tools.description: List the sport filters this server understands (canonical labels + common aliases like nba/nfl/nhl/mlb). Keyless, free.
